verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's proxy (gateway) caching docs state that its caching system stores and reuses LLM responses to save costs and reduce latency, which matches the story's gateway, cost and latency elements. The evidence is a single thin first-party statement repeated twice. missing for 10: details on cache backends and configuration (e.g. TTL, cache keys, semantic vs exact-match), per-request cache controls, independent or hands-on corroboration that caching works in practice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can cache responses at the gateway to cut cost and latency on repeated requests
